 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Anjani Kumar Sharan
 Oral Order

7 19-01-2023 Re.: I.A. No.02 of 2022 Heard Mr. Pushkar Narain Shahi, learned senior counsel assisted by Mr.
Rabindra Kumar Priyadarshi for the appellant and learned APP for the State on the instant interlocutory application.

Conviction has been recorded under Section 376 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 6 of the POCSO Act and rigorous imprisonment of 10 years has been awarded with a fine of Rs.50,000/-
under Section 376 IPC and rigorous imprisonment of 10 years and fine of Rs.50,000/- for the offence under Section 6 of the POCSO Act.
Earlier the prayer for bail of the appellant was rejected vide order dated 22.09.2020.
Patna High Court CR.
APP (SJ) No.4592 of 2019(7) dt.19-01-2023 It is submitted that the appellant is in judicial custody since 22.10.2017 and never released on bail till date.
Thus, he has remained in continuous custody for more than five years.
It is further submitted that appellant has served half of his sentence.

Learned senior counsel for the appellant relying on the various judgments of the Hon'ble Apex Court as well as this Court submitted that as the appellant has completed half of his sentence and there is no likelihood that this appeal may be taken up for final hearing in near future,
he may be released on bail.
